item.title: Cabell Huntington Hospital and St. Mary’s Medical Center joins Rivers Health in earning state pediatric emergency recognition
item.description: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. — The Emergency Departments at Cabell Huntington Hospital and St. Mary’s Medical Center have joined Point Pleasant’s Rivers Health in achieving the Always Ready for Kids recognition from the state of West Virginia, highlighting excellence in pediatric emergency…

item.title: Ohio secretary of state announces partisan candidates for 2026 primary ballot
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose has announced the list of partisan candidates who submitted petitions to run for statewide office in the May 5, 2026 primary election.

item.title: The Ariel Opera House to welcome spring season with two big shows
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — The Ariel Opera House will open its spring season with a lineup of high-profile performances, beginning with a Celtic-themed concert led by Maestro Peter Stafford Wilson on March 21.

item.title: Gallipolis City Commission receives updates from local officials
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — The Gallipolis City Commission approved a new ordinance and received updates on several ongoing city projects during its most recent meeting.

item.title: The Gallia County Commission approves status reports for local projects
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — The Gallia County Commission met in regular session Thursday to hear updates from county officials and review progress on several local infrastructure initiatives.

item.title: Traveling Bricks exhibition draws crowds to Bossard Library
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — An internationally toured LEGO exhibition is drawing steady crowds to the Dr. Samuel L. Bossard Memorial Library, with more than 1,800 visitors attending as of Feb. 4 since the display opened Jan. 17.

item.title: Ohio receives $14.7 million federal grant to support early care and education
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — Ohio has been awarded $14.7 million in federal grant funding to expand access to early care and education services, Gov. Mike DeWine has announced.

item.title: AACF accepting grant applications from Black-led and Black-serving organizations in Appalachian Ohio
item.description: NELSONVILLE, Ohio — The African American Community Fund, with support from its donors and in partnership with the Foundation for Appalachian Ohio, is accepting grant applications from Black-led and Black-serving nonprofit and public organizations serving Appalachian Ohio’s 32 counties.
